command:
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl jq ufw >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" >> /etc/hosts
if test -x /home/antrieb/startup.sh; then
  /home/antrieb/startup.sh >/var/log/infraset-grafana-loki-startup.log 2>&1
fi
timeout 120 sh -c 'until curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3100/ready >/dev/null; do sleep 2; done'
systemctl is-active --quiet loki.service
systemctl is-active --quiet grafana-server.service
chmod 0600 /etc/profile.d/antrieb-app.sh
systemctl disable --now ssh.socket ssh.service 2>/dev/null || true
node2_ip="$(getent ahostsv4 node2 | awk 'NR == 1 {print $1}')"
node3_ip="$(getent ahostsv4 node3 | awk 'NR == 1 {print $1}')"
node4_ip="$(getent ahostsv4 node4 | awk 'NR == 1 {print $1}')"
ufw --force reset >/dev/null
ufw default deny incoming >/dev/null
ufw default allow outgoing >/dev/null
ufw allow from "$node2_ip" to any port 3100 proto tcp >/dev/null
ufw allow from "$node3_ip" to any port 3100 proto tcp >/dev/null
ufw allow from "$node4_ip" to any port 3100 proto tcp >/dev/null
ufw --force enable >/dev/null
